parole.significato: un-; de- (attached to past participles, gerundives and some adjectives to negate them)
parole.testo: Probably of Slavic origin, possibly borrowed from Old Church Slavonic не- (ne-) or some other language (cf. Bulgarian and Serbo-Croatian не-), from Proto-Slavic *ne. Less likely, originally from Latin ne-, and reinforced or influenced by the Slavic prefix. Ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *né.
